title: Hausdorff operators and fractional Hausdorff operators in the Dunkl setting
summary: In this paper, we investigate the boundedness properties of the Dunkl-type Hausdorff operator on generalized Dunkl-type Morrey spaces and generalized Dunkl-type Campanato spaces. Furthermore, we introduce the fractional Dunkl-type Hausdorff operator and study its boundedness from $L^p(\mathbb{R}, dμ_α)$ to $L^q(\mathbb{R}, dμ_α)$. We also establish the boundedness of the fractional Dunkl-type Hausdorff operator on generalized Dunkl-type Morrey spaces under suitable conditions.
